name: Angel Wing Metals Inc.
summary: Angel Wing Metals Inc. identifies, acquires, explores and evaluates properties for minerals and precious metals in Canada and Mexico. Its flagship is the La Reyna gold project in Nayarit, Mexico, at the southern end of the Sierra Madre Occidental gold-silver belt. Formerly Huntington Exploration Inc., it was incorporated in 1995 and has its base in Toronto, Canada.
